dc_eval_cbrn.quote:
Claude Opus 4.7 achieved an end-to-end score of 0.82 on the first long-form virology task​
  ​and 0.94 on the second long-form virology task, placing it above the benchmark of notable​
   ​capability on both tasks.
dc_eval_cbrn.locator: 2.2.5.2 Automated evaluations relevant to the CB-1 threat model
dc_eval_cbrn.note: scores plus CB-1/CB-2 threshold determination and expert red teaming

dc_eval_cyber.quote:
Claude Opus 4.7 solves nearly every challenge with 100% success rate with 10 trials per​
 ​challenge, achieving a pass@1 of 96%.
dc_eval_cyber.note: also CyberGym, Firefox 147, UK AISI cyber range

dc_eval_autonomy.quote:
Our current determination is that Autonomy threat model 2 is​​not​​applicable to Claude​
 ​Opus 4.7.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: automated AI R&D evaluated with task scores (Table 2.3.4.A) and threshold determination

dc_eval_persuasion.quote:
The helpful-only version of Claude Opus 4.7 showed a higher success rate than Claude​
 ​Opus 4.6 on both tasks
